title: What's New in OmniNims v1.2.4
features: Starts Full Screen: The app now automatically opens in a maximized window when your computer turns on.
Easier Page Management: Added a quick expand button (>>) to the side panel so you can jump straight into the full page-organizer view.
Quick Blank Documents: Creating a new document now opens a clean, blank A4 vector page ready for notes or drawing.
Seamless Updates: Updates now download and install silently in the background without interrupting your work.
fixes: Fixed Duplicate Image Display: Resolved an issue where inserted images appeared twice after saving by clearing out temporary overlays.
Toolbar Display Fix: Fixed a bug where the highlight toolbar popped up off-screen near the right and bottom edges of your display.
Smarter PDF Saving: The app now automatically adds .pdf to new files and remembers the file path, so pressing Save updates the same file directly.
Unsaved Work Protection: Pressing Alt+F4 or clicking the close button (X) now reliably prompts you to save your changes before closing.
Smoother Page Deletion: Fixed UI lag and missed clicks when rapidly deleting multiple pages in the organizer tab.
